items.title: F3DZEX2, Wave, and other game-specific microcodes
items.behavior: These identities remain explicit non-aliasing HLE frontiers rather than being decoded as neighboring public GBIs. F3DZEX2's pinned RT64 BranchW delta is implemented and adversarially separated from F3DEX2 BranchZ inside both control-flow walkers. A behavior-bearing typed profile now survives shared/reference decode state and catalog-admitted self-load transitions, and all three typed variants apply the bounded NoN near-admission policy without changing the side/far raster-clipping handoff. A non-default, entry-only RT64 characterization transport derives an exact typed variant and logical plan from local raw windows while retaining native validation and rollback. Its admission-fixed repository suite expands eight policy rows into two public controls plus all six point-light hypotheses at each 16/24/32-byte candidate width; every subcase uses guarded fresh state, one FullSync, and exact task-workload-present pixel association. Candidate, knockout, and adaptive refinement vectors set G_LIGHTING plus G_POINT_LIGHTING; the directional control sets only G_LIGHTING and the disabled control sets neither. The typed Rust loader exact-matches canonical readiness and returns raw bytes captured while each window was read and hashed through one stable no-follow descriptor or Windows handle; Python is producer/oracle only. It is outside RenderBackend and has no admitted private behavioral result. Production admission remains closed while point-light behavior, exact F3DZEX2 raw-pair self-load resolution, and end-to-end differentials are incomplete. Unadmitted graphics images transactionally replay from untouched post-rspboot state through the manual-complete public RSP interpreter, and the accuracy policy can select that LLE path unconditionally before forwarding captured raw DPC work to the renderer.

evidence.needle: The instruction-level model is therefore manual-complete.

The deterministic reference rereads exact live source bytes, keeps correlated coverage, commits only after complete scanout, and orders coverage-AA or restoration before divot, vertical/horizontal resampling or replication, gamma, and bounded gamma dither. Native RT64 validates the programmed source span, synchronizes workload/present queues, and restores placeholder aliases before the Rust borrow ends. Its retained twenty-phase pinned-Metal gate proves exact causal/restorable gamma, seeded gamma-dither, coverage-gated divot, RGBA16 restoration, and scale behavior: divot changes twelve exact componentwise-median pixels; restoration changes eighteen eligible full-coverage pixels while twenty-four non-full and six flat full controls stay byte-identical and alpha is preserved. A separate adapter-capture integration test plus eleven-phase gate preserve supplied hardware mode 0 versus compatibility Unspecified across the wire and native callback, and apply the public Figure-11 kernel before divot. For deliberately generated managed codes 1-6, modes 0/1 match an independent per-code RGB5 CPU oracle at exact RGB8 vectors [50,45,35], [76,60,53], [102,70,75], [128,87,95], [158,95,109], and [185,113,128]; modes 2/3 restore the exact baseline; compatibility Unspecified matches replicate while explicit compatibility mode 0 matches AA.
